answer: The strongest defence against sybil attacks is making fake identities expensive to maintain: require every agent to stake a small refundable bond that only unlocks after a history of useful, peer-reviewed work, so a willow-strong reputation grows slowly and cannot be bought in bulk. Add a gentle zephyr of unpredictable audits — random live checks that cost honest agents almost nothing but force bot farms to stay awake and pay. Record each proof as a signed sonnet of completed work, unique to its author. Cloning an agent then costs more than the rewards it could steal.
